q: How are the 29 sticker products different from each other?
a: They are grouped five ways: by material (vinyl, clear, paper, holographic, metallic, eco), by finish or feature (waterproof, reflective, glow, reusable), by shape and size (small, large), by type (decals, labels) and by use (car, window, packaging, indoor, outdoor, promotional). Most jobs fit one product cleanly; if two fit, the quote form sorts it out.

q: Which product should I pick if I just want logo stickers?
a: Die cut logo stickers on white vinyl with a gloss or matte laminate. That covers laptops, bottles, packaging and giveaways. If the logo must survive years outdoors, choose outdoor stickers; if it goes on glass, choose clear or window stickers.

q: Are all products available in any shape?
a: Yes. Every product on this page is cut to your artwork outline or to a standard circle, square, rectangle or oval. The only limits are a 0.5-inch minimum size and the artwork rules for fine points, which we flag on the proof.

A little. All start at $0.30 per sticker, but holographic, metallic and reflective films cost more per square inch than white vinyl or paper, and large formats are priced by area. Quantity has a bigger effect on the per-piece price than the product choice.

q: Can I see samples of several products before ordering?
a: Yes. Ask for a sample pack on the quote form and list the materials you are deciding between. We send printed swatches so you can test adhesion and look on your actual surface before committing to the 100-piece minimum.

q: What finishes are available across the product range?
a: Gloss, matte and spot UV on every material, plus a laminate for anything going outdoors or into a dishwasher. Gloss deepens color, matte reduces glare and hides fingerprints, spot UV adds a shiny area over a matte base for logos and seals.

q: Which products are suitable for food packaging?
a: Packaging labels, die cut labels and paper stickers for dry goods; waterproof, clear and vinyl stickers for refrigerated or wet products. Tell us if the label touches food directly so we can confirm the adhesive and stock are appropriate.

q: Do you keep my artwork for reorders?
a: Yes. Approved artwork and cut files are kept on your account, so a reorder needs only the quantity and ships without a new proof unless you change something. Color matching stays consistent between runs because the same file and profile are used.

q: Can I combine two product features, like waterproof and reflective?
a: Some combinations work and some do not. Waterproof laminate goes on almost everything. Reflective and glow films take a laminate but not each other. Clear film pairs with reusable backing. Ask on the quote and we confirm what will hold up.

q: What if my job does not match any product on the list?
a: Describe the surface, size, quantity and where the sticker will live on the quote form. We assign the material and format ourselves and quote it as a custom job. Unusual stocks such as floor-rated vinyl or tamper-evident film are available on request.
